trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] WITH DISTINCT p, COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14') AS end_date WITH p.position AS position, CAST(split_part(end_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(split_part(end_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) OR (CAST(split_part(end_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AND CAST(split_part(end_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) < CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age WITH position AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2 RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL WITH p.position AS col1, CAST(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), 1, 4) AS INT64) - CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS age RETURN col1 AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(p.position) IN ['frontcourt', 'backcourt'] WITH CASE WHEN LOWER(p.position) = 'frontcourt' THEN 'Frontcourt' ELSE 'Backcourt' END AS col1, CAST(SPLIT_PART('2026/10/14', '/', 1) AS INT64) - CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS age RETURN col1 AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
